titles.title: Untitled (Abstraction Green Line and Red Circle)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: A thick green line runs horizontally through the center of the paper.  The paint is most saturated on the upper edge of the line; it lightens towards the lower edge.  A red circle intersects the upper edge of the line near the center of the work.
